content: Implement controller and routes with middleware for user search endpoint
activeForm: Implementing controller and routes with middleware for user search endpoint
description: Implement user-search.controller.ts with searchUsers handler for GET /api/users/search. Controller processes query parameters, calls search service (T5.2), applies pagination, and returns formatted results with metadata. Create user-search.routes.ts to register the search endpoint with Express router, including middleware chain (query validation, rate limiting). Implement middleware for query parameter validation using Zod schemas from T5.1 and rate limiting per IP to prevent abuse. Write 8 MVP-tier tests (4 unit tests for controller query handling, filter application, error handling, and result formatting; 4 integration tests for route behavior covering 200 success responses, 400 validation errors, pagination headers, and rate limiting). This subtask completes the API layer and builds on the service layer (T5.2) to expose the search functionality via HTTP endpoints.
